title: L3: Score 4 labels-only frozen arms on the final slice (bound ~2,400; owner go required)
description:
## Purpose

The headline comparison on the disjoint final slice: labels-only learning from disagreements.

## Scope

A, F, F-rand, A+F (A/A+F = A-c/A-c+F frozen with empty comments) through reloaded bundles on the final slice; arm 0 free from cache. Only after the owner's explicit go.

## Request bound and cost cap

Bound ~2,400 Jev requests (use the printed bound). Cap: ~$2.40; cumulative must stay <= $10. Fresh ledger for this stage; gate needs `--max-new-requests` >= printed bound and <= ceiling; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class. Counts toward the hard cumulative cap of $10.

## Stop-point checks

Owner go recorded in a comment before the run; cumulative spend checked against $10.

## Definition of done

Final table: macro-F1, acc, per-class recall, confusion matrix, top-label Brier/ECE, paired bootstrap vs arm 0 and vs 0.649.
